# linearizability-checker

> Deterministic linearizability checker for concurrent execution histories using Wing and Gong search with Lowe pruning, key partitioning, and minimal counterexample generation. Go module `github.com/Trysac/u402-linearizability-checker`, package `linearizabilitychecker`, MIT licensed,
> Go >= 1.23, standard library only.
